title: Halden: station blackout and vital DC
description: A bounded station-blackout exercise on the fictional current four-loop PWR. Unit 2 starts at its standard full-power operating point. At +10 seconds the offsite supply is lost and both emergency diesels fail to start. The ordinary protection and turbine-driven auxiliary feedwater systems must respond. Run the model-scoped ECA-0.0 task to verify actual feedwater delivery, shed discretionary UPS loads and inspect finite battery support. A battery storage isolator can demonstrate why an energized charger during normal AC does not prove backup storage is connected. This exercise does not qualify full station-blackout endurance, FLEX recovery or real-plant operation.
objectives: Advance past the loss of AC power and inspect actual bus, reactor-trip, turbine-driven AFW and battery feedback.
Ask the Assistant to run ECA-0.0 on Unit 2. Follow actual feedwater delivery and load-shedding evidence, then assign the next continuing duty.
Compare an isolated storage battery, a closed motive-steam path and actual restoration of an available AC source with the normal response.

environment.model: Fictional finite AC/DC support exercise; no real plant operating qualification

guidance.title: Station blackout and vital DC
guidance.message: Loss of offsite power and unavailable diesels are scheduled at +10 s. Use Guide and inspect the actual response and cue outcomes. If an Assistant provider is available, request ECA-0.0 for Unit 2 and follow its real criteria, AFW and battery evidence.

cues.title: Offsite loss with emergency diesels unavailable

guide.title: Inspect a station blackout
guide.description: Supervised process-model exercise using ECA-0.0; it is not an operational qualification.

steps.title: Identify Unit 2
steps.instruction: Locate the exact Unit 2 object and open its model-backed display. Read the starting state and current time before the scripted event.

steps.title: Advance to the initiating event
steps.instruction: Advance the shared Run ten simulation seconds. Inspect the admitted cue and actual feedback; a failed or uncertain cue is not a completed initiating event.

steps.title: Ask the Assistant
steps.instruction: Review the target and explicitly send or edit this request. Inspect the actual ECA-0.0 execution and its admitted criteria. If no provider is available, Skip the response task and inspect the same model and procedure evidence manually.

action.text: Run ECA-0.0 for Halden Unit 2 using admitted criteria. Report actual reactor, AFW and battery evidence and propose the next continuing duty.

steps.title: Inspect achieved response
steps.instruction: Observe actual reactor, auxiliary-feedwater and battery feedback; distinguish command delivery, achieved response and remaining DC time.

steps.title: Keep the comparison independent
steps.instruction: Copy the Run before trying loss of cooling, a wrong order or source restoration. Confirm the new Run identity and checkpoint. Compare achieved response at equivalent times; never reset this Run merely to make a guide fit.

steps.title: Choose a continuing duty
steps.instruction: Inspect the remaining criteria, unresolved alarms and sustaining conditions. Name who or what will monitor the continuing duty. Continue acknowledges the handoff discussion; it does not close a procedure or prove continuing performance.

steps.title: Continue exploring
steps.instruction: This guide is finished. The same Run remains available. Pause or stop guidance whenever you wish; those controls do not pause the shared simulation. Copy the Run before trying a different intervention. Acknowledgements record your choice to continue, not a qualification.
